window: Day20 h0 inclusive -> Day24 h0 exclusive for SELL; Day24 h0 retained as endpoint snapshot
observed_shape: Across all five Battles, Day20->24 realized SELL cash residual is strongly opponent-positive (+18,609 to +34,040) and closely matches the scale of Cash-residual growth (+20,905 to +32,607), without asserting identity because other cash flows also occur.
Mean realized-SELL residual is +24,752 while mean Cash-residual growth is +25,678.8.
The Day20 starting stockpile does not explain the late SELL/Cash difference by itself: mean starting liquidatable-inventory mark residual is +5,642.6, far smaller than the realized SELL residual.

STRAWBERRY is the largest robust positive SELL-cash component: mean opponent-minus-self SELL units +78.4 and SELL cash +17,323.2. The opponent begins only +10.8 STRAWBERRY units ahead on average and ends +27.2 ahead.

MELON and WOOL start with zero quantity residual in all five Battles, yet opponent-minus-self SELL units become +12 MELON in every Battle and +20 to +36 WOOL; both end with opponent-positive inventory. These sellable units therefore arrive during Day20->24 rather than merely being liquidated from the Day20 stockpile.
WHEAT moves in the opposite direction: self sells more WHEAT in all five Battles (mean residual -69.8 units, -3,168.6 Cash), partially offsetting the opponent advantage elsewhere.

For products sold by both sides, realized-price means are generally close relative to the unit/composition gaps; the robust late residual is observed primarily in what and how many units reach SELL rather than as a broad opponent price premium.
boundary: No item-level lineage from earlier committed production to later SELL is proven; identical value units were not tracked across State transformations.
Starting inventory and later SELL are not equated because inventory can be replenished by harvest/drop during the window.
Realized SELL residual and Cash-residual growth are close in scale but are not identical because purchases, HIRE, LAND and other cash flows also occur.
No SELL policy, BUY policy, Action diagnosis, profitability conclusion, Representation, Evaluation, Direction or Candidate is inferred.

The observation weakens a separate-surface reading: Day20->24 contains sellable units created during the same interval, so Market/Cash realization remains visibly connected to ongoing asset/output flow.

reentry.purpose: Explain the large terminal self residual using the public world map before internal diagnosis.
reentry.current_position: Day20->24 is not merely liquidation of a fixed inventory stock. The opponent-positive Cash pulse is accompanied by large in-window SELL-unit arrival, especially STRAWBERRY plus newly appearing MELON/WOOL, while self WHEAT sales partially offset it.
reentry.next_question: On the world asset-formation map, what public State/time positions feed the Day20->24 STRAWBERRY/MELON/WOOL sellable-unit arrivals, without yet diagnosing Action or policy?
